_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2024 10-K): Our business operations are subject to the cyclical and volatile nature of the supply-demand balance in the chemical industry.; of the other live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names chemicals or refining, and the FY2024 10-K names no cloud, offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming, electric vehicles, crypto, or GLP-1 drugs; the FY2024 10-K names generative AI only in its data privacy and security risk factor ('In addition, the complex and dynamic regulatory environment surrounding artificial intelligence (“AI”), including generative AI, subjects us to a variety of risks.'), not as a substitute for the products LyondellBasell makes; EV's 'auto parts suppliers' and 'fuel retail' name no LyondellBasell business: its 10-Ks say its products go into 'automotive components' among many uses, and its Houston refinery's refined products are ENERGY_TRANSITION's refining; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the Refining segment refines crude oil and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for LyondellBasell

theme_watch.reason: Live: LyondellBasell's own FY2024 10-K says 'Refining. Our Refining segment refines heavy, high-sulfur crude oil and other crude oils of varied types and sources available on the U.S. Gulf Coast into refined products, including gasoline and distillates.' and, of greenhouse gas laws and regulations, 'several state governments have promulgated regulations directed at GHG emissions reductions from certain types of facilities, and additional regulations could be forthcoming, that could result in increased operating costs for compliance, required acquisition or trading of emission allowances, or other costs. … Additionally, demand for the products we produce may be reduced.' The stock trades at 11.8x FY26E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ENERGY_TRANSITION) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing decarbonisation of LyondellBasell's refining and the demand for its products specifically.

price rich; Ratio B 8.80x; +69% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.10; conservative 2yr -1%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -55.7%/yr (worst year FY15-FY24, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -5.4%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY25 median

BULL.desc: EPS -5.4%/yr (FY15-FY24 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +66.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY24, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2026-01-30) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 8.80x (89.8% downside to Bear $5 / +10.2% upside to Bull $54) | Adj composite 1.50 vs market 2.60: gap -1.10 [OVERVALUED] | +69% above the EPP floor $29 (7x FY26E $4.14) | Conservative 2-yr case: -0.9% total (-0.5%/yr) | At 11.8x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $65 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas -109.6% and Intermediates & Derivatives -32.8% operating income in Q4 2025, forward revenues -9.2% (no FY26 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2025 revenues as reported); the energy transition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
